title: Inkling 2 Mini: what fits on a laptop, step by step
intro: Slide through the model’s size, the computer it needs, its coding scores and what its looping design changes, using Thinking Machines’ own figures.
note: All figures are from Thinking Machines’ announcement and model card. The benchmark scores are the lab’s own and have not been independently checked; the lab says evaluation setups vary by model. The looping results come from a separate research version of the model with a variable number of loops, not the released model itself. Memory needs depend on the software you run it with.
